expired oxygen generators loaded as cargo without safety caps.

When one activated, it made heat and pure oxygen.
Cargo holds now carry detectors and fire suppression.

script.spoken: FIRE BURNS THROUGH THE FLOOR. A cargo fire burned into the cabin, and everyone aboard died. The fuel for that fire was in boxes of oxygen generators. They had been labelled as empty. In fact they were expired but still live, with no safety caps. When one activated, it made heat and pure oxygen. The hold had no smoke detector and no way to fight fire. Cargo holds now carry detectors and fire suppression.
